items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: You had Junior Mance and Bob Cranshaw and what’s his name out in Philadelphia I think.

ctx.x: Jimmy Forrest. You understand what I mean? There was ego conflict. Now the rhythm section was okay I think. You had Junior Mance and Bob Cranshaw and what’s his name out in Philadelphia I think. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
